meta.report: WA cluster allocation of unallocated strongs
meta.author: le Roux Cilliers
meta.prior_output_reference: consumes uploads cluster.csv, cluster_strong.csv, strong_without_cluster.csv; obslog wa-obslog-global-cluster-alloc-v1-20260811.md

decisions.F2: T2 for every strong that does not denote inner being
decisions.F3: schema: strongNumber, stepGloss, stepTransliteration, language, cluster_code, short_name, confidence, rationale, review_flag, alt_clusters
decisions.F4: FLAG reserved for IB-but-no-cluster (rare); FLAG never auto-assigned from cluster.csv gloss list
decisions.multi_cluster: permitted (not the norm); alt_clusters lists co-candidates

method: Precedent-grounded. cluster_strong.csv (2801 prior labels) + cluster.csv gloss/translit lists used as precedent.
P1 = exact gloss-string in prior labelled allocations; P2 = exact gloss-string in a cluster.csv gloss list; P3 = normalised transliteration in a cluster.csv gloss list.
HIGH = single-cluster precedent grounded in gloss (P1 and/or P2). Translit-only (P3) singles demoted to MEDIUM (homonym risk).
MEDIUM = precedent conflict (multi-cluster), or translit-only, or seat-word->M47, or non-IB/concrete->T2 (F2), or profile token-overlap suggestion.
LOW = no precedent and weak/no token signal.
Profile scores are decision-support only; they never drove HIGH.
meta.caveat: Evidence is gloss+transliteration+count only; no verse-level data. Extract-level, not verse-exhaustive.
meta.note: Ready for application (no researcher decision required). Single-cluster, gloss-precedent grounded.
